archive.sha256_origin: independently computed over all compressed bytes

limitations: Recorded GPU loss diagnostics are checked for binding and finiteness, not recomputed without feature NPZs.
All training draw descriptor hashes are independently reconstructed; saved feature arrays and native hidden states are not replayed.
Frozen native equality is verified from full per-tensor digest receipts; native model weights are not downloaded here.
Selector losses are sampled training-minibatch values, not held-out or full-corpus accuracy.
This verifies recorded training and checkpoint integrity, not rollout quality or generalization.
scope: archived metadata/provenance reconciliation and safe CPU checkpoint reload
